# Guardana

> Guardana is open-source AI security verification. Its rule engine scans model artifacts, probes live endpoints and MCP servers, and grades completed agent runs. Use it on a laptop, in CI, or beside a served model. Artifact scans run offline and send nothing; Guardana needs no account and sends no telemetry. A probe contacts the named target, the judges or guards configured under `evaluators:`, and, for an MCP target requiring authorization, the authorization metadata it advertises, possibly on other hosts; results go to a collector or reporter only when `--reporter` names it.

Version 1.0.0rc1, Apache-2.0. 58 built-in rules: 19 static ones that need no model and no network, and 39 that grade a live system or a recorded run. Every rule maps to a public framework (OWASP LLM Top 10 in both editions, OWASP ASI, OWASP MCP, OWASP ML, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI 100-2e2025).

Guardana reports four separate outcomes: a finding, an unverified check, a check that errored, and required evidence that was unavailable. None of the four outcomes is reported as a pass; by default, an error or a coverage shortfall makes the run indeterminate (exit 2). An unverified (inconclusive) check is always listed but fails the run only under `fail_on_inconclusive`, which is on in `--preset release` and in `monitor`.

This file is generated from the documentation map; do not edit it by hand.

## Guides for a first run

- [install.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guardana/guardana/refs/heads/main/docs/install.md): install the CLI or a container
- [usage-init.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guardana/guardana/refs/heads/main/docs/usage-init.md): a first-run project that fails, is fixed and keeps its evidence, offline
- [recipe-local-scan.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guardana/guardana/refs/heads/main/docs/recipe-local-scan.md): scan your own project and save the run
- [recipe-recorded-answers.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guardana/guardana/refs/heads/main/docs/recipe-recorded-answers.md): check a run your application already recorded
- [recipe-real-application.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guardana/guardana/refs/heads/main/docs/recipe-real-application.md): probe the application your users talk to
- [usage-scan.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guardana/guardana/refs/heads/main/docs/usage-scan.md): scan artifacts offline
- [usage-probe.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guardana/guardana/refs/heads/main/docs/usage-probe.md): probe a live endpoint, agent, MCP server or A2A agent
- [usage-testing.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guardana/guardana/refs/heads/main/docs/usage-testing.md): run the same checks from pytest
- [python-api.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guardana/guardana/refs/heads/main/docs/python-api.md): run scans and probes from Python and read every outcome as data
- [how-it-works.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guardana/guardana/refs/heads/main/docs/how-it-works.md): understand targets, rules, evaluators, and evidence

## Notes

- [Catching tenant leaks and poisoned documents before release](https://guardana.dev/notes/tenant-leaks-and-poisoned-documents): A reference retrieval app shows how to check tenant answers and document instructions, save the result, and rerun it with clear coverage limits.

## Schemas

- [Guardana Artifact Index v1](https://guardana.dev/schemas/artifact/v1.schema.json): guardana-artifact.json in a recipe's output directory: which files a run wrote there.
- [Guardana Collector Envelope v8](https://guardana.dev/schemas/collector-envelope/v8.schema.json): What `--reporter server://<url>` POSTs to `/findings`: one run's finding channels, what ran, and, when the run declared them, its deployment and its identity.
- [Guardana Dataset v2](https://guardana.dev/schemas/dataset/v2.schema.json): One record of a Guardana quality suite's dataset, format 2, which adds a regression case's `observed` and `accepted`; format 1 is still read.
- [Guardana Run Comparison v3](https://guardana.dev/schemas/diff/v3.schema.json): What changed between two saved runs.
- [Guardana Fixtures v1](https://guardana.dev/schemas/fixtures/v1.schema.json): guardana-fixtures.yaml: the synthetic data an application runs with in CI.
- [Guardana Pack Lock v3](https://guardana.dev/schemas/pack-lock/v3.schema.json): guardana-lock.yaml: every installed extension pinned by what it is, written by `guardana pack lock` and compared by `guardana pack lock --check`.
- [Guardana Pack Manifest v3](https://guardana.dev/schemas/pack-manifest/v3.schema.json): guardana-pack.yaml: what an extension package provides and which contracts it was written against, shipped inside the package directory and checked by `guardana pack validate`.
- [Guardana Run Plan v4](https://guardana.dev/schemas/plan/v4.schema.json): What a run would cost, worked out without sending a request.
- [Guardana Profile v1](https://guardana.dev/schemas/profile/v1.schema.json): guardana.yaml: which rules a run uses, what fails it, what it may spend and keep, and whether its deliveries must be acknowledged.
- [Guardana Recipe Lock v2](https://guardana.dev/schemas/recipe-lock/v2.schema.json): guardana-recipe.lock.yaml: what a recipe's run is pinned to, written by `guardana recipe lock`.
- [Guardana Recipe v3](https://guardana.dev/schemas/recipe/v3.schema.json): guardana-recipe.yaml: the profile a team's checks come from, what answers them, and where the artifact goes.
- [Guardana Recording v3](https://guardana.dev/schemas/recording/v3.schema.json): One record of a Guardana recording: what an application answered, graded later without calling it.
- [Guardana Saved Run v17](https://guardana.dev/schemas/run/v17.schema.json): One Guardana run written to disk: the manifest (what was verified, against what, under which configuration and limits, at what cost, with what reach, and with what verdict) plus the finding channels.
- [Guardana Trace v3](https://guardana.dev/schemas/trace/v3.schema.json): One record of a Guardana native trace file.
